reason_note: Human authority confirmed all five semantic policy candidates. HC-000001: bare marketplace counters remain unknown until an explicit sold/order/review/item-role label exists. HC-000002: price temporal semantics are revised and confirmed as follows: when a price is observed on a current active official business webpage used to advertise product prices, and there is no contrary evidence that the display is historical, treat it as current_advertised_price at observed_at; do not infer transaction price, all-branch price, or variant equivalence. For API, rendered DOM, structured responses, exports, snapshots, archives, caches, or other acquisition methods, acquisition technique alone does not determine temporality: use source temporal evidence. Evidence known to be historical is historical_observed_price with its observation/effective time where available; unresolved temporality is temporal_status_unknown. Temporal status remains a separate axis from price role such as current/from/promotional/discount/member/unknown_display_price. HC-000003: product identity match does not imply variant match without explicit variant-equivalence evidence. HC-000004: default/recommended displayed order remains display-order-only and is not demand/popularity/national rank without an explicit sort contract. HC-000005: when cloud access is blocked but the same technique succeeds in a separately approved normal-network environment, classify it as an environment boundary rather than technique failure.
